differences: The ANOVA of the post-rest RT improvement: the paper reports F(1, 155) = 14.49 (eta2 = .08) for break time and 5.79 (eta2 = .04) for on-task trial time. In the converted rows 14.49 and eta2 = .08 belong to the on-task trial length (30 s vs 10 s trials) and eta2 = .04 to the break length, so the labels appear swapped in the text; the break-length F is 6.99 here, not 5.79 (probably a typing slip). The interaction F = 1.217 matches.

The paper's reactive-inhibition t-tests for the 30 s trials (t(36) = -3.42 and t(40) = -3.26) cannot be reproduced: the authors' script has no code for them, and the closest version computed here gives t = -4.19 and -3.49. The same tests for the 10 s trials, the four post-rest t-tests and the ANOVA reproduce.
The authors' script treats trial 38 (the second warm-up of the spaced groups) as part of the post-rest window for the paired t-tests (trial >= 37); that is reproduced as is in the checks.
